environment.description: AWS Lambda function running Python 3.9 runtime in us-east-1, deployed via SAM template with default execution role (AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole). Lambda is behind API Gateway HTTP API with no additional middleware. IMDSv1 is available on the Lambda execution environment's network interface. No VPC attachment - function runs in Lambda's shared network space with direct access to IMDS endpoint. DNS TTL caching is minimal (Python's socket.gethostbyname does not cache across calls in Lambda).
